test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?**

1. It cut off oxygen and prevented the usual decay caused by air, moisture, and bacteria.

2. The excavation of Pompeii provided a remarkably well-preserved glimpse into life in ancient Rome.

3. When the eruption occurred, a thick layer of hot ash and pumice rapidly buried the town.

4. Unlike other ruins, Pompeii remained frozen in time due to Mount Vesuvius' sudden eruption.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph discusses the preservation of Pompeii due to Mount Vesuvius' eruption, and how the excavation provided insights into ancient Roman life.
 
• **Sentence 2 is the first sentence**, as it introduces the discovery of Pompeii and its significance:
 
 
• "The excavation of Pompeii provided a remarkably well-preserved glimpse into life in ancient Rome."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 follows**, as it explains why Pompeii was unique among ruins:
 
 
• "Unlike other ruins, Pompeii remained frozen in time due to Mount Vesuvius' sudden eruption."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 is the third**, as it describes the immediate event during the eruption:
 
 
• "When the eruption occurred, a thick layer of hot ash and pumice rapidly buried the town."
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 is the last**, as it explains the scientific reason for the preservation:
 
 
• "It cut off oxygen and prevented the usual decay caused by air, moisture, and bacteria."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **2-4-3-1**.
